ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISCHANGED(TotalHouseholdIncome__c), ISCHANGED(ApprovedTreatmentFunding__c), ISCHANGED(FundingTier__c) ), OR( (ISPICKVAL(Status, "Not Approved")), (ISPICKVAL(Status, "Approved")) ), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "IVF_Application", RecordType.DeveloperName = "IVF_Application_Read_Only" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot edit the Total Household Income or Funding Tier or Approved Treatment Funding after the application is approved/Not Approved
